name: FlagEmbedding GitHub repository (BAAI BGE retrieval toolkit)
notes: README positions FlagEmbedding as 'BGE: One-Stop Retrieval Toolkit For Search and RAG'. Houses the BGE model family (bge-m3, bge-large, bge-reranker series) plus related models: LLM-Embedder (arXiv 2310.07554), BGEmbedding (arXiv 2309.07597), C-Pack. MIT licence. Note the org moved from BAAI/FlagEmbedding to FlagOpen/FlagEmbedding - the old path returns 404 on the GitHub API as of 2026-10-04. API metadata 2026-10-04: created 2023-08-02, last push 2026-08-24, 12212 stars, 927 forks, 918 open issues, not archived, no GitHub releases, homepage bge-model.com.
